prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE very simple, polished terminal application symbol for Retty, inspired by the attached reference image. The reference establishes the desired simplicity: one dark rounded-square tile and only a clean >_ terminal prompt. Design a fresh version with the same restraint.
Retty is a native Mac/iPhone terminal app for persistent sessions and reconnection across screens. The visual should feel calm, approachable, fast and reliable. Express this mainly through a terminal prompt, not through added illustrative symbols.
Canvas approximately 1536 × 1536, square. Place one upright dark midnight slate #252733 rounded-square tile, centered, occupying about 90% of the canvas. Use beautifully continuous soft rounded corners, matching native desktop app icons. The entire area outside that one tile must be genuinely transparent. No scene, screenshot, desktop surface, mockup or frame.
Inside the tile: exactly TWO bold simple graphic strokes making >_. A fresh mint-green #74EB87 greater-than chevron at the left, and a short warm-white #F6F4EB underscore at the lower right. The chevron has two clean gently curved diagonal arms joined into one clear right-pointing form; only a very slight elastic bend in the arms, not a hook, spiral or extra arrow. The tips and joint are softly rounded, substantial and clean. The underscore is a short thick horizontal bar with subtly rounded ends. The chevron is the dominant element. Let the underscore sit just below the chevron's central point, with clear comfortable spacing, as in a familiar command prompt. Align and optically center the entire >_ group inside the tile. Keep ample breathing room, the group occupying approximately 50% of tile width and 40% of tile height. Match the stroke weight of both components.
Visual treatment: nearly flat, understated, tactile only in the gentlest sense. The dark tile may have an almost imperceptible top-to-bottom tonal shift, but no gloss, dramatic shading, outer cast shadow or raised glossy symbol. All symbol edges must be crisp and clean. Strong recognition at 32 × 32.
Avoid: lettering, app name, R monogram, faces, mascots, eyes, smiles, chain links, infinity glyphs, stars, reconnect diagrams, circles behind the mark, extra accents, buttons, texture, thin lines, decorative details, dramatic gradients, reflections, beveled 3D or perspective. Show one finished native-looking simple terminal symbol only.
